messages.subject: RE: Error Lavaan while cfa with same variables and same indicators works?
parts:
Ellen—

This looks like a syntax error in your structural model.  It may be just a matter of case, or something simple like that.  Can you please share your model syntax and the command you used to call lavaan to estimate the structural model?

--Ed Rigdon

 

From: lav...@googlegroups.com [mailto:lav...@googlegroups.com] On Behalf Of ellen.r...@gmail.com
Sent: Thursday, October 23, 2014 8:26 AM
To: lav...@googlegroups.com
Subject: Error Lavaan while cfa with same variables and same indicators works?

 

Dear all,

I'm trying to run a Lavaan model. It has run before, but now I added a latent factor. My measurement models with cfa run and give good results, but when I turn to the Lavaan model, I get the following error: 

Error in lav_data_full(data = data, group = group, group.label = group.label,  : 
  lavaan ERROR: missing observed variables in dataset: T1AD
I have searched into the code to find any missing variables or type errors, but everything is consistent with the CFA indicators... Where did it go wrong? 

Can it happen that the CFA doesn't give an error, while actually there should be one? 

Kind regards and thanks in advance! Ellen Peeters

--

Dear Ed,

Thanks for your fast response! Apparently it was a type error; the strange this is that the type error (an '+' was missing) was part of the short model. It only gave an error when things were added to the model.

Kind regards, Ellen
